title: Supply Chain Attack on @ledgerhq/connect-kit
technical_mechanism: malicious versions injected wallet drainer via rogue WalletConnect project; ~$610k lost
summary: A malicious package '@ledgerhq/connect-kit' was discovered in the npm ecosystem. The attack involved compromised maintainer + crypto drainer. Mechanism: malicious versions injected wallet drainer via rogue WalletConnect project; ~$610k lost
